title: Nourishing Sweet Tunisian Red Peppers Tagine
description: A garlicky and shattering lazy-sunday Tunisian dish featuring sweet red peppers, this tagine is perfect for a relaxing day at home, and is ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly, meaning it promotes balance and calmness.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is softened and translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the sliced red bell peppers and cook until they start to soften.
Add the ground cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the chickpeas and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, or until the peppers are tender.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
